info.title: Cutlass agent API
info.summary: Drive the Cutlass video editor from any agent or script over loopback HTTP.
info.description: Every route needs the bearer token from the token file that endpoint.json names. Changes need the edit lock: call POST /v1/lock/acquire, then send its lockId as X-Cutlass-Lock. Replies are the envelope {revision, warnings, result} or {revision, error}. POST /v1/call runs any tool by name and is the simplest entry point for a harness. Timeline positions are integer frames; source times are flicks (705600000 per second).

servers.description: The loopback server; use baseUrl from endpoint.json.

post.description: Runs a tool by its MCP name (cutlass_split) or catalog name (edit.split) with its arguments. The reply is always the envelope: image tools answer with pngBase64 in result, describe with result.text. Lock tools need X-Cutlass-Lock.

parameters.description: The lockId; required by tools that need the lock.
